_comment: lumen bridge config — read once at bridge startup. Runtime calls in the editor (artnet(), sacn(), osc(), mock()) override whatever is set here, so this file is really just the default for a freshly started bridge. See the DMX output configuration section of the README.
_comment_host: artnet.host: 127.0.0.1 only reaches software on THIS machine. For real hardware use either your subnet broadcast (e.g. 192.168.1.255 — reaches every node, easiest) or a single node's IP (e.g. 192.168.1.50 — unicast, quieter on the network). Check which subnet your lighting network is actually on; Art-Net gear is often on 2.x.x.x or 10.x.x.x rather than 192.168.x.x.
